# Transfer log

transfers.txt is one day of storage operations, space separated, no header: ts host op bytes note.
Rows whose op is MARK are window markers (the marker name is in note). The real sync window runs from `SYNC-BEGIN` to `SYNC-END`; the `-TEST` markers belong to a dry run and do not count.
Host names are whole values: `s3-eu2` is another host from `s3-eu`.
